maria (SecEng): Heads-up — noticed a batch of stale Snyk suppressions and GHAS codeql filters that are hiding infra IaC alerts. Also seeing a handful of scanner jobs failing with KMS decrypt errors when fetching private terraform modules. Can we triage?

aj (Platform): Yup saw the KMS failures in yesterday's run. Example log: `error: failed to decrypt envelope: AccessDenied; operation=Decrypt; principal=scanner-service-account`

sec-bot: scanner-orch detected 9 failures in the last 24h for repo=infra-modules, reason=KMS_DECRYPT_FAILURE

sam (DevEx): For suppressions — we have a `.snyk/suppressions.yml` file with entries that reference PRs from 2023. I suspect the owners moved teams. We should avoid silent suppression drift.

leo (Infra): @maria @sam I can run an ownership sweep. Quick approach: map suppression IDs to the last-modified commit and link to PR author. If orphaned, create an issue and auto-CC oncall.

maria (SecEng): Proposed quick plan: 1) triage KMS failures (high priority) 2) list suppressions > 6mo and try to contact owners 3) enable GHAS IaC alerts for one repo as a canary 4) run full scanner after fixes.

emma (SRE): For KMS: scanner cluster uses the cross-account key in prod-kms. Looks like the scanner IAM role lost `kms:Decrypt` after the role rotation. Quick fix is to re-attach the small policy: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":["arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01"]}
  ]
}
```
Then redeploy scanner nodes.

aj (Platform): Adding to that — we should also make scanner retry decrypts with exponential backoff. There's a small race where role propagation failed during the rotation window. I'll open a PR to the scanner chart to add retry/backoff config.

sam (DevEx): On the suppression cleanup, here's a one-liner to list suppressions and last commit: `git log -n1 --pretty=format:\"%h %an %ad\" -- .snyk/suppressions.yml` — we can then correlate to PRs with GH API and slack mentions. I'll script it.

maria (SecEng): For GHAS IaC filters — currently we have `policy: ignore-terraform` in the org-level filter. I'd like to enable IaC alerts for `infra-modules` only and send them to #eng-security for 48h before rolling org-wide. Can we do that?

leo (Infra): 👍 yes. I'll create an allowlist for that repo and flip the filter. Will also add a clipboard note for security playbook.

emma (SRE): After fix, run a canary job: `./tools/scanner/run.sh --repo infra-modules --branch main --canary` and confirm no KMS errors for 24h.

maria (SecEng): Action items: - @emma fix KMS policy and redeploy scanner (ETA today) - @aj PR for retry/backoff (ETA tomorrow) - @sam script to map suppressions and open issues for orphaned entries (ETA EOD) - @leo enable GHAS IaC for infra-modules as canary (ETA today)

aj (Platform): I'll also add a small telemetry flag to the scanner job that reports `kms_decrypt_retries` to console so we can validate backoff effectiveness.

sec-bot: note created: SECURITY-2389 "stale-snyk-suppressions-cleanup" assigned to sam (DevEx)

maria (SecEng): Thanks all. If anyone hits blocked perms ping me and I'll escalate with infra. Let's recheck status in this thread when each ETA lands. :thumbsup:

sam (DevEx): I'll post the first draft script here when ready.

leo (Infra): On it.

emma (SRE): Redeploy started — will update once canary completes. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
